label: An actual cause of being that itself has an actual cause causes being PER_SE_5, as caused
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: for every actual cause c of the esse of x (ActualEsseCause, mode unspecified, tenseless), if c itself has an actual cause of its esse, then c causes the esse of x per se, as caused (AsCaused c x): among actual causes of being, a caused cause's being caused is never accidental to its causing being. It denies, for causes of esse, the per accidens order that ST I q.46 a.2 ad 7 allows for generators ('generat enim inquantum homo, et non inquantum est filius alterius hominis'); ad 7 does not state this bridge. Its warrant would come from reading a cause of esse as one on whose own continued being its causing depends (the cause-of-esse versus cause-of-becoming distinction), which the tenseless ActualEsseCause does not encode. PerAccidensRegressControl satisfies the per se regress and the other-cause step without it.
